newsitem.title: CANADA: NOVA expands Alberta petrochemical plans.
newsitem.headline: NOVA expands Alberta petrochemical plans.

text.p: NOVA Corp said on Wednesday it would expand plans for an addition to an Alberta petrochemical complex and build a new plant at the site.

NOVA said plans for an expansion of of its Joffre, Alberta ethylene complex, announced last year with partner Union Carbide, would be changed to increase the plant's intial capacity to 2.8 billion pounds per year.
NOVA, which last year said the complex would produce 2.0 billion pounds per year, said the expansion plant, called EIII, would cost C$865 million and start producing by the year 2000.
